description: Land Acquisition - Block No. 2 & 4, Sooripaluwa & Ihalakaragahamuna, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District and Amendment to the Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 2001/9 of 11.01.2017, Kobeigane D/S Division.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land descriptions, claimant information, and acquisition procedures, which squarely fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
